canonical_identity.title: Mundari.in cultural, language and worship media website
canonical_identity.scope: Mundari-labelled language/cultural/religious media; item-level provenance and cultural scope unresolved

verified_provider_statements.observation: The site states that it contains Mundari cultural and worship videos, songs and pictures and is viewable in English and Mundari.
The site states that it is sponsored by Munda Sabha Ranchi and, unless noted otherwise, copyright for all materials is held by Munda Sabha Ranchi.
The cultural-video page currently surfaces Dance, National service, and mund durang labels.
The cultural-song page currently surfaces Country service, Flower, King of nation, Lets go to war, Baa badi re, and Kita galang labels.
The song-text page exposes downloadable Mundari-labelled song-text files.

canonicalization.rule: Treat home page, cultural-video, cultural-song, Christian-song, gallery, song-text and download manifestations as components of one provider website identity unless item-level provenance establishes a distinct upstream work/source.
canonicalization.independence_warning: Multiple pages or media members on the same provider do not constitute independent corroborating source identities.

rights_access_consent.copyright_holder_statement: Unless noted otherwise, Munda Sabha Ranchi
rights_access_consent.decision: external-locator-only pending item-level rights, provenance, consent and cultural-access audit

promotion.reason: Provider copyright and public download/listen affordances do not establish an open redistribution licence, item-level participant consent, or cultural-access clearance; item-level linguistic/cultural claims have not been independently verified.

exact_locator_readiness.scheme: canonical page URL + displayed item label; add immutable capture/hash and media member URL/hash only after lawful capture and item-level audit
remaining_gates: Mundari variety and transcription/translation validation where applicable

audit_invariants: public download affordance does not equal open redistribution licence
provider copyright does not equal participant consent
community-organization sponsorship does not by itself establish community-wide cultural clearance
website page/member multiplicity does not equal independent source corroboration
media title/label does not by itself establish a cultural claim
